<div class="card-body">
'''Rebel Reinforcements''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">反乱軍増援兵</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手の場のカードのキャラクターと宇宙船の数の合計が、自分の合計より多いとき、1フォース消費して運命数を引く。その数の分の反乱軍兵士またはYウイングをロストデッキから取り戻して再使用できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-106o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍は、帝国各地に潜伏している幾多の小グループによって構成されている。兵士や宇宙戦闘機は秘密基地から出撃し、いかなるときでも戦場に駆けつける。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rebel Reinforcements.

'''Card text:''' If the opponent has more total characters and starships on table, use 1 Force to draw destiny. Retrieve that many Rebel Troopers and/or Y-wings from the Lost Pile.

'''Lore:''' The Rebellion is made of hidden cells across the Empire. Troops and starfighters strike from secret bases at any time.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rebel Reinforcements]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
